At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. The BC04 draws 100 W, about $7 a month at 10¢. You're buying a draw at a full block every ten minutes, forever, plus steady sats to your own wallet.

What do you pay per kWh?

At 14¢ the BC04 costs about $10 a month to run — 100 W, 72 kWh. For $249 that's a machine drawing at a 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, round the clock, for years, and stacking sats to your own wallet meanwhile.

Is this your first miner?
Well it can't stack sats and have a shot at the 3.125 BTC block

You're right, and that's fair. You point it at one or the other: a solo pool for the block shot, or a regular pool for steady payouts. It's a setting you can change any time, so you can switch month to month. Which way were you leaning?
